profile.headline: Senior Solution Consultant
profile.summary:
11 years of software industry experience in Requirements Analysis, Design, Development and Testing with specialization in Enterprise applications development in J2EE.
• Masters degree in Computer Science, Bachelors degree in Computer Engineering.
• Expertise in Enterprise Application Development using JAVA, Servlets, JSP, EJB, JDBC, JMS,  
  XML,XSLT, WebServices.Expertise in Java and J2EE Design Patterns, MVC Frameworks and  
  UML.
• Utilizing Java, Spring Framework (Spring Core, Spring JDBC, Spring MVC, Spring Batch, Spring Integration, Spring Security), JMS, javascript, Oracle, Intersystems Cache.
• Strong knowledge and experience working with DB2, Informix, Netezza, Oracle, Sybase, MSSQL 
  and MySQL database and good knowledge and experience in SQL and PL/SQL programming.
• Have extensive client interfacing experience. As an analyst at client site, taken up responsibilities 
   like analysis of new business requirements and new customer implementations, design and 
   development of various modules in enterprise applications.
• Hands on experience  in monitoring and maintaining ETL (Extraction Transformation and 
   Loading) tool.
•  Author of DataStudio Book 3.1.
•  Wrote and Published numerous developerWorks Article.

Specialties:
 Sterling Commerce Distributed Order Management System (DOM), Sterling Commerce Business Intelligent (SBI), Sterling Store Order Management(SOM),Cognos Business Intelligent server, Cognos Adaptive Warehouse, Cognos Adaptive Warehouse Runtime and Cognos Adaptive Analytics  Eclipse plug-in development, Eclipse RCP Development, Data Studio, Rational Data Architect, Rational Software Architect, Project Planning, Team Collaboration, Team  Building, System Architect, Agile, Scrum.
